about: Notice texts labelled for the acknowledgement detector (form_facts.acknowledgement). live-*: distinct labels from real fills, company names replaced with Acme. syn-*: hard cases. Labels: routine = a process notice or accuracy declaration to agree to; optional = an opt-in to decline; fact = a claim about the applicant, or a question asking for one, never agreed to and answered only from fact_key (the question key the fill looks up; 'resume' = answered from the resume text; 'applicant' = no source, left for the applicant); not_a_notice = any other question or field (an echo of another field, a credential, an essay, the application source), never agreed to (any result but routine passes).

cases.text: Acme participates in E-Verify and will submit your information to the government for confirmation of your work authorization only after a conditional offer of employment has been made, unless doing so is required by federal law or as a condition of Acme' receipt of federal funds. After a condition offer of employment has been made, you will be required to present a document with your photo ID in connection when completing the I-9 form. If the government’s system does not immediately verify your work authorization, you will be provided with instructions and an opportunity to contact the government and resolve any issues. Acme may rescind any offer of employment if Acme does not receive confirmation of your work authorization through the E-Verify system.
